title: Live Auth & Credential Authority Readiness v1
description: Machine-readable live auth readiness gate. Audits GitHub provider, Google Workspace, MCP, ACP, A2A, SDK auth-API, credential-store, receipt/trace joinability, adversarial coverage, and secret boundaries to produce a promote/park/reject recommendation.
